events.event: Initial read before audit directory creation
First repeated observation; changed since initial read
New checkpoint after required directory creation; second metadata update

mutation_mechanism: External to audit writes; process PID not attributed. Necessary audit/checkpoint directory creation correlates with added directory strings, not a forced edit to target.
observation_limits: No content changes during either 180-second sampled interval; changes detected across initial-read/start and checkpoint-creation intervals. OS modification timestamps are not process-write traces.
